name: once-upon-a-diff
description: Once Upon a Diff's entry shell: bin/once-upon.mjs (the once-upon command and `serve`), the usage probe it preloads, and the integration tests that drive the server, the CLI and the core together

scripts.test:extension: node ../../server-libs/foundation/src/node-version.mjs && yarn workspace @once-upon-a-diff/extension build && node test/browser/load-test.ts
scripts.test:expand: node ../../server-libs/foundation/src/node-version.mjs && yarn workspace @once-upon-a-diff/extension build && node test/browser/expand-test.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json && tsc -p test/browser/tsconfig.json
